definitions.explanation: The social rules and customs that govern polite behavior; proper conduct in social situations.

examples.japanese: {礼儀|れいぎ}{正|ただ}しい{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: They are a person with good manners.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{礼儀|れいぎ}を{教|おし}える。
{目上|めうえ}の{人|ひと}に{対|たい}しては{礼儀|れいぎ}を{守|まも}らなければならない。
examples.english: You must observe proper etiquette toward your superiors.
examples.notes: 礼儀を守る = to observe proper etiquette

notes:
USAGE: {礼儀|れいぎ} refers to the established norms of polite behavior in society. It encompasses both formal manners and everyday courtesy.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{礼儀|れいぎ}{正|ただ}しい (polite, well-mannered)
・{礼儀|れいぎ}を{守|まも}る (to observe proper etiquette)
・{礼儀|れいぎ}を{知|し}らない (to have no manners)
・{礼儀|れいぎ}{作法|さほう} (etiquette and manners)

CONTRAST:
・{行儀|ぎょうぎ} - refers more to behavior/conduct, especially of children
・{礼儀|れいぎ} - broader concept of social courtesy and respect
